_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Statistically honest coil call: score almost never leaves the band in recent windows, so hold Anxiety until a real flow or vol breaker appears.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes on current phase Anxiety; Narrative has no explicit forward call so Analyst HOLD/Anxiety carries
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays rangebound, fear stuck near 30, no vol expansion that pushes score out of Anxiety
next_move.invalidated_if: Fast range break with fear into low-20s (toward Panic) or ETF/stablecoin bid return with fear thaw lifting score toward Complacency
